read: AI-hardware rally extending into midday off CoreWeave's Q3 report (Nov 10 after close; the 11:37/11:45 headlines are recaps of it): MU, LITE, MRVL, MPWR, SMCI +10-15% at 90-100% of range, QQQ +2.7% at its high, while software (MSFT -2.6% at a day low on 1.7x vol, ACN, ADSK) and staples/consumer (LULU, GIS, KMB, MCD, NKE) bleed. The catalyst is a day old and already in both the gaps and the since-open legs, so buying at the top of the range is chasing; there is no named reason for an exhaustion fade, and a search found no dated news behind MSFT's intraday slide, so shorting it would be a price pattern the desk has already failed. No trade. Intraday book empty (10:30 had no trades), nothing to close. Morning book (not mine): CI short working (-1.6% since open), COST about flat, AMGN about flat, NVDA short against (+1.8% since open with semis). Spike pod quiet, nothing to flag.
